items.title: RT by @ChrisO_wiki: Finland has completed a 200-kilometre fence along its eastern border with Russia. The fence is 4.5m high and equipped with technical surveillance systems and flanked by patrol roads. It covers about 15% of Finland’s border with Russia. The project cost €356 million, Yle reports. Finland's Interior Minister Mari Rantanen said there may be a need to extend the fenced sections in the future.
items.summary:

Another Russian command post near Velyka Novosilka was also struck. Russian losses and the extent of damage are being assessed. #Ukraine

items.title: Russia struck Kyiv with ballistic missiles overnight, killing 2 people and injuring at least 10, Ukrainian authorities said. Damage to civilian infrastructure was reported at more than 16 locations across five districts. Residential buildings, warehouses, garages and an educational facility were among the sites damaged, with fires reported at several locations. Earlier, emergency services said 13 people had been rescued as crews worked across the capital. #Ukraine

items.title: RT by @RALee85: Latest on Ukraine talks: People familiar with the talks in Kyiv tell @FT Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner brought updated versions of earlier documents, revised to reflect the changed circumstances since peace negotiations stalled in February, at the outset of the US war with Iran. But the Trump envoys came with few new ideas, the people said, and were instead seeking to revive earlier proposals and to narrow differences between Kyiv and Moscow. A central issue is the remaining Ukrainian-held territory in the Donbas, which Russia has claimed as its own but has failed to capture despite years of fighting. The eastern region, some 75% of which is under Russian control, is a red line for Zelenskyy, who has insisted that Ukraine would never hand over that territory or any other territory that Moscow’s forces occupy. https://www.ft.com/content/1e2d9db0-cb2c-4c79-942b-f0aff960e4c5?syn-25a6b1a6=1

items.title: RT by @RALee85: In the first half of 2026, military spending accounted for 44% of all Russian federal budget spending, a new all-time high. Links to the data below. 👇
items.summary:
In the first half of 2026, military spending accounted for 44% of all Russian federal budget spending, a new all-time high. Links to the data below. 👇

items.title: Police in Kyiv blocked off a street where a shoot out and stand off occurred between members of the SBU and GUR. 3 GUR officers were reportedly wounded. Yesterday, GUR’s Russian Volunteers Corps said that’s its deputy commander had been abducted by unknown individuals, and SBU and GUR said they had foiled a FSB plot against a leader of a Russian opposition political movement. Officers from the State Bureau of Investigation (SBI) and the commander of SBU Alpha showed up to defuse the stand off. The SBU says its officers did use force but only after coming under armed attack while conducting an investigative action regarding the FSB plot. Regarding the events, Kyrylo Budanov said, "The State Bureau of Investigation will now deal with the situation. It is important to ensure a thorough and impartial investigation, but no one has the right to abduct servicemen with impunity, open fire in the streets of our cities, or issue or carry out criminal orders." https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/09/02/8051502/ https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/09/02/8051496/ https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/09/02/8051477/ https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/09/02/8051467/
